Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a triplex SILAC approach combined with affinity purification (RNA-tagging/IP) to identify RNA-binding proteins. Acquisition is DDA based on the use of Proteome Discoverer and standard MS/MS search descriptions for an Orbitrap Fusion.

scope: we employed a CGG repeat RNA-tagging system to capture repeat-associated RBPs by mass spectrometry in mammalian cells
By co-expressing an epitope-tagged coat-binding protein, PCP, we were able to isolate CGG repeat RNAs and associated RBPs

For IP, 3 mg of total protein was used for each lysate. Lysates were first incubated with 40 μl of pre-washed protein G beads for 30 min at 4°C to block any non-specific interaction, then incubated with pre-washed 40 μl of packed M2 FLAG beads (Sigma) rotating at 4°C for 4 h

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment used a tagging system (PP7-tagged RNA and PCP-NLS-3xFLAG) to affinity-purify ribonucleoprotein complexes from HEK293T cell lysates for LC-MS/MS analysis.
